ev.q: Since May 1999, 86 cases of acute flaccid paralysis (AFP) have been reported in Iraq.
Nine of the 16 case-patients with confirmed wild poliovirus were members of nomadic cattle-herding families
Fourteen case-patients were aged less than or equal to 2 years, and 11 had not received oral poliovirus vaccine
Preliminary genomic sequencing results indicate that the polioviruses in Iraq are similar to polioviruses in southeastern Turkey in 1998
